game: PIT @ TB, Week 6 2026, morning-of pack only. Kickoff time and dome/outdoor not in pack. Spread TB +2.5 (PIT -2.5), total 38.5. Weather not saved.

script.base: Low-total, short-spread grind. PIT is a 2.5-point favorite with implied totals PIT 20.5 / TB 18.0, so the book expects a close game PIT leads, not a blowout, and not many plays. With Baker Mayfield out and no backup named in the pack, TB's path is to hide the QB: Bucky Irving carries and short throws, not explosives. PIT can lean Jaylen Warren (49 carries, 321 rush yards in weeks 3-5) and does not need a shootout. Pace slow, run-lean, limited garbage time.
script.flip1: The unnamed TB quarterback can't move it, PIT leads by 10+ after halftime, and TB abandons the run. Irving's rushing line dies; TB WR/TE targets rise on a bad offense; Warren's carries go up while DK Metcalf and Pat Freiermuth targets stall. Starters are not a late-snap risk at only 2.5, so this flip is moderate, not a blowout flag.
script.flip2: TB stays within a score on the ground and PIT never pulls away. Both lead backs keep full snaps. A 42% TB blitz (PIT EPA/db -0.38 vs blitz, 0.00 vs none) pushes Aaron Rodgers to Jaylen Warren checkdowns instead of Metcalf shots. A true shootout is the unlikely third path given the 38.5 total and Mayfield out.

injury_fallout: Known from the pre-game injury report in the pack, not final inactives. TB QB Baker Mayfield Out (thumb): entire TB pass game downgraded; no replacement named, so no passing prop is usable. TB S Antoine Winfield Jr. Out (rib) and CB Benjamin Morrison Doubtful (quad): missing safety helps PIT deep shots; a doubtful outside CB helps PIT WRs if he sits. TB WR David Sills Out is a non-factor vs the listed target list. TB RB Sean Tucker Questionable (quad): if out, carries stay with Irving (52/272 L3), Jalen Daniels (14/89) and Kenneth Gainwell (10/19). TB LBs SirVocea Dennis and Josiah Trotter Questionable: if both sit, hook/middle (already 9.25 YPA) gets softer for Warren, Freiermuth and slot types; not confirmed. PIT WR Roman Wilson Out (finger): 13 targets, 134 yards, 234 air yards in the L3 leave the offense; that air is Metcalf/Bernard/Pittman's problem, not Warren's (Warren air was -21). PIT WR Ben Skowronek Out. PIT TE Pat Freiermuth Questionable (calf): if limited or out, Darnell Washington (12 targets, 106 yards L3) and Warren are next, but he is not ruled out so this is not a confirmed sleeper. PIT RB Rico Dowdle Questionable (toe): Warren already had 49 of ~56 RB carries in the L3 window, so the over does not need Dowdle inactive; if Dowdle plays he is a small vulture, not a committee flip. PIT S DeShon Elliott Out (knee): helps TB deep shots (Egbuka, Hurst), which a backup QB may not be able to use. PIT CBs Jalen Ramsey and Jamel Dean Questionable as listed; PIT DT Keeanu Benton Questionable (ankle) could soften the interior Irving would run at. Final inactives ~90 minutes before kick are not in the pack.

matchup.shell: No coverage chart, MOFO/MOFC or man/zone rate in the pack. Proxy only: TB YPA allowed left 6.59 (78), middle 9.25 (32), right 6.48 (56). The bleed is the middle, not the perimeter. PIT YPA allowed is flat and mediocre: left 7.35 (77), middle 7.27 (33), right 7.54 (48).
matchup.pressure: TB blitzes 42%. Rodgers/PIT EPA per dropback is -0.38 vs blitz and 0.00 vs no blitz, so pressure that gets home should cut deep WR yards and push checkdowns to Warren and the TEs. PIT blitzes only 27%; TB EPA/db is -0.21 vs blitz and -0.10 vs none, so blitz is not the TB story. Mayfield being out matters more than PIT's blitz rate.
matchup.bleeds: TB run defense does not bleed: 3.61 YPC allowed and only 9 runs of 10+ in 5 games. TB pass defense bleeds in the middle (9.25 YPA) and has a thinned back end (Winfield out, Morrison doubtful). Explosive pass count in the pack is 20+ pass 14/172, cited as labeled, not re-interpreted. PIT run defense does bleed: 4.21 YPC and 13 runs of 10+ in 5 games. That is Irving's spot, not a pass-catcher spot.
matchup.overlap: The core overlap is TB's 42% blitz plus the middle-of-field bleed versus Warren's checkdown role (16 targets, 169 yards, -21 air in three games), not Metcalf's 243 air yards into a 6.5 YPA perimeter. Wilson's vacated 234 air yards overlap the compromised TB secondary, but the same blitz that makes that secondary attackable is the thing that has crushed PIT (-0.38 EPA). Irving overlaps PIT's soft run defense, but Mayfield's absence makes that script-dependent.

form: Avoiding season averages; weeks 3-5 plus listed last-4 only. Warren is the offense: 49/321 rush and 16/169 receiving in three games; last-4 rushrec 77, 176, 126, 188 and rush 43, 127, 93, 101. The 43/77 game is the floor; the 127 and 188 are the spike. Metcalf last-4 rec 27, 31, 115, 12 — the 115 is one-play/one-game inflation against a 50.5 line, and L3 yards (158) equal 31+115+12. Freiermuth last-4 32, 30, 17, 44 on a 33.5 line, and he is questionable. Bernard 35, 14, 11, 80 and Washington 7, 67, 27, 12 are spike-driven; no two-sided price. Irving last-4 rush 89, 46, 61, 165 and rushrec 90, 58, 61, 175; the 165/175 is the fluky game, and 46/61 sit under 64.5. His receiving is noise (1, 12, 0, 10). Godwin 46, 25, 31, 37 and Otton 38, 56, 37, 25 have cleared modest lines, but that is role average into a QB who is now out. Hurst 36, 27, 40, 25 on 6 targets and 98 air is explosive-sample, not a stable role. Dowdle last-4 rushrec 21, 44 as a backup, and he is questionable.

Blowout flag is off, so starter snap risk is low. Mayfield out is the override: TB pass-yardage overs are downgraded; a close game can still feature Irving carries. PIT 20.5 is enough for a bellcow to pile scrimmage yards without a shootout.

Questionable only, not sleepers: Dowdle, Freiermuth, Tucker, Ramsey, Dean (listed PIT), Benton, Dennis, Trotter, Garnes. No same-position line movement diff was saved.

edge_players.edge_sentence: Warren is the PIT offense (49 carries and 16 targets in three games) and the checkdown answer to a 42% blitz that already makes this offense worse, into the only soft TB zone (middle 9.25 YPA), so 91.5 scrimmage yards is the number that still works even if Tampa's 3.61 YPC run defense takes away the cheap rushing efficiency.
edge_players.must_be_true: Warren plays his full bellcow role, Dowdle (questionable, toe) does not take a real share, the game stays inside one score or PIT leads so carries survive, and at least the usual checkdowns show up when TB blitzes. Freiermuth's calf cannot be both active and the only outlet. No snap limit is listed for Warren.
edge_players.kills_it: TB's front (3.61 YPC, 9 runs of 10+ in five games) holds him near 40 rushing yards and the blitz becomes sacks rather than checkdowns (PIT is -0.38 EPA vs blitz), or Freiermuth/Washington take the middle and he finishes in the 70s the way the 77 rushrec game already showed. A late Dowdle vulture on a short week of touches also kills a fat 91.5.

data_check.notes: No sims, no model file, no Pinnacle, no live weather, no final inactives. Anchor fair on the leg is consensus no-vig 0.500 at -115/-115. Hand sketch, not a sim: 15-16 carries at a blended ~4.0-4.5 YPC is about 60-72 rush yards, plus 35-45 receiving yards if the blitz checkdown role holds, which still clears 91.5; if carries fall to 12 and receiving dies, it does not. TB 3.61 YPC disagrees with a pure rush over and is why this is a flag, not a size-up. It does not by itself push the combined sketch under 91.5, so the lean is not auto-cut. Treated as under 70% on purpose (a naive 3-of-4 hit rate would be the 70% trap). Dropped, not flagged as bets: Irving rush over 64.5 (PIT allows 4.21 YPC and 13 runs of 10+, but last-4 is 89, 46, 61, 165, margin over 64.5 is a couple of yards, Mayfield-out trail flip kills it, pre-mortem stronger than the read); Warren rush under 60.5 (strong run defense market rule, but positive script and 3 of 4 recent overs disagree — lean plus disagree = drop); Metcalf under 50.5 (blitz and 27/31/12 form, but Winfield out and Morrison doubtful disagree — lean, drop); all TB receiver overs (averages into a QB who is out, lines already ~50% no-vig); Freiermuth and Dowdle (questionable, snap-limit unknown); Rodgers rush 0.5 (price looks broken vs 5, 12, 6 recent yards). No prop cleared a real 3-point model gate.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and Warren under 91.5 lost the ticket because Tampa's 3.61 YPC front, the best unit in this pack, stuffed the 6.55 YPC he posted in weeks 3-5, the 42% blitz showed up as sacks and throwaways rather than screens (the -0.38 EPA is the warning), and Freiermuth played through the calf and took the middle that averages 9.25 YPA. Dowdle was active and took the goal-line and a few checkdowns. Warren finished with something like the 43-rush / 77-scrimmage game already on the card, and the 176 and 188 were the spikes the 91.5 was taxing. The counter is real enough to keep this a lean and a flag, not a strong bet. It is not stronger than the role-plus-checkdown read, so it is not a drop. Irving was dropped here: an 18-point implied total, a split last-4, a 165-yard outlier, and a trail-and-abandon flip outweigh the 4.21 YPC matchup.
slip_story: Single-script grind, not a parlay. Story is PIT slight lead or a one-score game, low total, TB blitz, Warren touches in both phases. He is the only leg. Do not stack Metcalf or Egbuka overs (they need explosives this blitz and this total do not), do not stack a game over, and do not pair him with an Irving over that dies if PIT actually leads. If a second leg is forced later, it has to be the same grind, and nothing else in the priced board cleared the pre-mortem.
